'''Bertrand Blanchet''' (19 September 1932 – 23 October 2025) was a Canadian [[Roman Catholic (term)|Roman Catholic]] prelate.

Born in [[Montmagny, Quebec]], Blanchet was ordained to the priesthood in 1956. He was appointed bishop of [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Gaspé|Gaspé]] in 1973. He later served as [[archbishop]] of [[Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Rimouski|Rimouski]] from 1992 until his retirement in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.catholic-hierarchy.org/bishop/bblanchet.html|title=Archbishop Bertrand Blanchet|access-date=16 February 2022|publisher=[[Catholic-Hierarchy.org]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cccb.ca/media-release/archbishop-bertrand-blanchet-receives-honorary-doctorate/|title=Archbishop Bertrand Blanchet receives honorary doctorate|publisher=[[Canadian Conference of Catholic Bishops]]|date=28 October 2008|access-date=16 February 2022|location=[[Ottawa]], [[Ontario]]}}</ref> Blanchet died on 23 October 2025, at the age of 93.<ref>[https://dioceserimouski.com/actualites/deces-de-mgr-bertrand-blanchet/ Décès de Mgr Bertrand Blanchet] {{in lang|fr}}</ref>
